characters.name: Natan
characters.description: Natan, boy about 8 from the tribe of Asher, slim, warm olive skin, straight black hair in a short bowl cut, big serious dark eyes, knee-length olive-green tunic with a yellow woven belt, sandals; wears a small carved wooden olive leaf on a cord (the emblem of Asher).

characters.name: Father
characters.description: Natan's father, man about 35, strong and calm, olive skin, short black beard, kind tired brown eyes, knee-length sand-brown tunic with an olive-green sash and a dark-brown cloak, simple head cloth; carries a plain leather shoulder bag. When leaving, a plain bronze-colored leather traveling vest (no weapon visible).

characters.name: Mother
characters.description: Natan's mother, woman about 33, slender, olive skin, dark eyes, black hair under a long saffron-yellow head scarf, ankle-length rust-red dress with a cream sash.

characters.name: Moses
characters.description: Moses, older man about 80, tall and lean, weathered olive skin, long grey-white beard, deep calm eyes, simple undyed cream wool robe with a brown cloak, plain head covering; holds a tall wooden shepherd's staff.

characters.name: Pinchas
characters.description: Pinchas son of Elazar, young priest about 30, tall, olive skin, short dark beard, earnest focused eyes, white linen priestly tunic with a blue sash and white turban; carries two long silver trumpets.

characters.name: Elazar
characters.description: Elazar the High Priest, man about 55, sturdy, olive skin, full dark beard streaked with grey, kind serious eyes; priestly garments: white linen tunic, deep-blue robe with pomegranate hem, colorful woven apron, breastplate of twelve colored stones without engravings, white wound turban.

cover.prompt: At the edge of the desert camp at sunset, Father in his traveling vest kneels and holds Natan in a tight, joyful hug, lifting him off his feet, both eyes closed and smiling. Mother stands behind with her hands over her heart, tearful and happy. Tents and the Jordan river with green hills behind. Warm golden light, medium shot, no weapons anywhere.

pages.prompt: Natan sits at the entrance of his family tent in the plains of Moab, chin in his hands, gazing across the Jordan river at the green and blue mountains of the Land of Israel. Behind him the camp is quiet: adults walk slowly with sad, downcast faces. Soft late-afternoon light, wide shot with the far mountains glowing.

Father sits down beside Natan on a woven mat by the tent, arm around him, explaining quietly with a serious, gentle face. Natan looks up at him with worried eyes. In the far background, beyond the camp, faint hills where another people live. Muted dusk light, intimate close-medium shot.

Moses stands alone outside the Tent of Meeting, eyes closed, listening, his face calm and accepting, with a soft warm light glowing over him from the cloud above the tent. In the foreground, Natan sits with Father, looking toward Moses in alarm, and Father speaks to him softly. Golden evening light, wide shot.

Men of the twelve tribes gather around Moses with heavy, loving faces, some reluctant, lingering close to him, one old man holding Moses' hand. Moses gestures firmly but kindly. Among the men of Asher, under a flag with an olive tree emblem, stands Father. Natan watches from behind a tent pole. Midday light, wide shot.

Morning of departure at the camp's edge: Mother hugs Father tightly; Father bends to kiss Natan on the forehead, and a tear rolls down Natan's cheek. Behind them, a column of men in traveling clothes sets out, led by Pinchas lifting two silver trumpets to his lips, the sound shown as soft golden waves in the air. Pale dawn light, emotional medium-wide shot.

Days of waiting: inside the tent by an oil lamp, Natan and Mother stand side by side praying, eyes closed and hands folded. Through the open tent flap the camp is still and quiet, no children playing, a single toy lying in the sand. Deep blue evening light outside, warm lamplight inside.

A messenger runs into the camp waving joyfully, and people come out of their tents, faces lighting up with relief. Natan runs as fast as he can toward the edge of the camp, his olive-leaf cord flying, his face hopeful and determined. Bright morning light, dynamic wide shot following Natan.

Outside the camp boundary, the returning men stand in a long line on the sand, tired and dusty, carrying bundles. Father, among them, waves to Natan from a distance with a tired, loving smile and a gently raised hand meaning 'not yet'. Natan stands at the camp edge, arms half-reaching out. Warm afternoon light, wide shot showing the space between them.

Evening inside the tent: Natan sits on Mother's lap, looking up at her with a puzzled, slightly upset face. Mother strokes his hair and explains gently. Through the tent opening, far away, a small cluster of tents outside the camp with tiny campfires where the returning men rest. Soft lamplight and blue dusk.

Outside the camp, Elazar the High Priest teaches the returning men how to purify their vessels: one man holds an iron pan in a bright fire until it glows, another dips a pot into a big cauldron of boiling water, and others immerse cooking vessels in a clear pool. Father carefully dips a clay jug. Steam and warm firelight, busy medium-wide shot.

Officers stand before Moses with a long cord of knotted counting strings and pebbles in baskets, smiling broadly as they report that no one is missing. Moses' face fills with gratitude. In the foreground, Natan jumps with joy and throws his arms around Mother's waist. Bright midday light, medium-wide shot.

The army officers bring gifts to the Tent of Meeting: baskets and cloths full of golden bracelets, rings and earrings shining in the sun. Moses and Elazar receive them with grateful faces and carry them toward the Mishkan entrance. The officers bow their heads in thanks. Warm golden light, reverent wide shot.

Inside the family tent after seven days: Father steps through the entrance, washed and in clean clothes, and lifts Natan high in a big tight hug, Natan's legs kicking happily. Mother smiles with tears in her eyes, her hands clasped. An oil lamp glows on a low table; Father's face is quiet and thankful, eyes closed as he holds his son. Warm golden evening light, close-medium shot.

Night over the whole peaceful camp near the Jordan, seen from a little hill: tents glowing with lamps, families together at their tent doors hugging, a soft white cloud glowing over the Mishkan. In the foreground, Natan sits between Father and Mother, all three arm in arm, looking up at the stars. Calm, grateful, wide shot.
